guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: weeks in a sprint, points a person finishes in a focused day, days after which a card or blocker is too old, healthy bug share, capacity limits.

Fill Projects with the projects that run sprints: manager, client, sponsor, client contact and vendor with their phones. Open points, ready points, velocity, the forecast date and the board counts fill in by themselves.
Fill Team with each person and Epics with the big pieces of work of each project. Then add every item to Product Backlog with its epic, type, priority, story points and status.

Create each sprint on Sprints with its dates, goal and committed points. Record the days and focus of every person on Sprint Capacity to see the capacity in points and a check against what is assigned.
During the sprint put the cards on Board Cards, set the limits on Work in Progress Limits and write each stand-up on Daily Stand-ups. Blocked cards and old cards show in red and amber.
Count the points remaining each day on Burndown Data and read the line against the ideal. The sprint shown on the chart is the one typed in the setting on Start.
When a card is finished add it to Cycle Times to see the cycle time and the cards finished each week. Record every blocker on Blockers with its cause, owner and dates.
After each sprint fill Sprint Reviews with the points accepted, Velocity by Sprint with a note, Retrospectives with the mood and Retrospective Actions with an owner and a due date for each action.

Use Backlog Refinement for your refinement sessions, Release Plan for each release and Acceptance Criteria so that done means the same for everyone. Working Agreements keeps your team rules and shows when to review them.

Use the 13 calculators for capacity, velocity, sprints left, the burndown check, the release date, points to days, work-in-progress limits, cycle time, the commitment, backlog health, bugs, epics and a what-if.
Print 10 sheets and 9 reports, follow 9 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text and the number ready.
Read Sprints and Boards Dashboard and Charts every week: velocity, completion, blocked cards, cycle time, bug share, open retrospective actions and the sprints left.
Delete the demo rows when you are ready and type your own. Every calculated column, figure and chart then works with your data.

listing.title: Project Manager Sprint Planning and Task Board Excel Template: Backlog, Velocity, Burndown, Kanban, Retrospectives
listing.headline: Plan sprints, run the board and forecast the release in Excel
listing.description:
Run the tasks of a team in sprints and on a board, in one Excel workbook for the project manager or PMO lead who looks after several projects at once. Product Backlog holds every item with its epic, type, priority, story points, status and sprint, and shows by itself which items need an estimate, which need an owner, which are ready and which are done. Epics roll the points up and tell how many sprints each one still needs.

Sprints and Sprint Capacity turn the days and the focus factor of each person into capacity in story points and compare it with what the team committed. Velocity by Sprint keeps the average of the last three sprints and the trend, Burndown Data draws the remaining points against the ideal line with a projection, and Projects forecasts the sprints left and the date the open backlog is done.

Board Cards, Work in Progress Limits, Cycle Times and Blockers show where work waits: blocked cards, cards in work too long, columns over their limit, the cycle time of every card and the days each blocker has been open. Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews with accepted points, Retrospectives with their actions, Backlog Refinement, Release Plan, Acceptance Criteria and Working Agreements cover every meeting and rule of the sprint.

13 calculators cover capacity, velocity, sprints left, the burndown check, the release date, points to days, work-in-progress limits, cycle time, the sprint commitment, backlog health, bugs, epic forecasts and a what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 9 reports, follow 9 checklists and send 28 ready messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part six of the Project Manager suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for six sprint projects to explore first. It helps you plan and follow your work and does not promise results.

signature.name: Release plan with days to the date
signature.why: each release has a target sprint, a date and a state, with the days to go and the client contact to tell

signature.name: Backlog health score for every project
signature.why: ready points, estimates, bug share and old blockers combine into one score from 0 to 100 and a ready or not ready verdict

signature.name: Acceptance criteria with who checked them
signature.why: each item carries its criteria and whether they are met, so done means the same thing for the team and the client

competitors.lacks: give you columns and cards but no story points, velocity, burndown, work-in-progress check or capacity per sprint
charge for every user each month and keep your backlog on their server; no capacity check, no client acceptance record and no forecast date
one list with a status column; no sprints, no epics, no cycle time, no blockers with days open and no retrospective actions
plan phases and dates but cannot hold a backlog, an estimate, a sprint commitment or a team velocity
tick tasks off with no owner load, no definition of done, no review with accepted points and no way to forecast the finish

documents.title: Sprint plan for the team and the client
paragraphs: Sprint plan of {set:firm}, dated {today}.

Sprint {col:sprints.number} of {col:sprints.project}, ID {col:sprints.sprint_id}. Status: {col:sprints.status}. The sprint runs from {col:sprints.start} to {col:sprints.end}. Project manager: {col:sprints.pm_name}.
Sprint goal: {col:sprints.goal}.

The team commits {col:sprints.committed} story points against a capacity of {col:sprints.capacity} points. In the backlog {col:sprints.assigned} points are assigned to this sprint. The commitment check shows: {col:sprints.commit_check}.
A plan above {set:over_pct} of the capacity needs work taken out before the sprint starts. A plan below {set:under_pct} leaves room for another item from the ready backlog.
An item enters the sprint only with an estimate, an owner and acceptance criteria. New work enters during the sprint only when something of the same size leaves it.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Sprint review summary for the sponsor and the client
paragraphs: Sprint review summary of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:reviews.project}. Sprint {col:reviews.number}, review on {col:reviews.demo_date}. Presented by {col:reviews.presenter}.

The team committed {col:reviews.committed} story points and finished {col:reviews.done_pts}. The client accepted {col:reviews.accepted} points, so {col:reviews.to_accept} points still wait for acceptance. The state of the acceptance is: {col:reviews.state}.
Feedback of the client: {col:reviews.feedback}. Next step: {col:reviews.next_step}.
Sponsor: {col:reviews.sponsor}. Client contact: {col:reviews.client_contact}. Points are accepted when every acceptance criterion of the item is met.
Please send any change request before the next sprint planning, so that we can size it and place it in the backlog.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Velocity and forecast report for a project
paragraphs: Velocity and forecast report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:projects.name} ({col:projects.code}). Client: {col:projects.client}. Project manager: {col:projects.manager}.

The average velocity of the last three closed sprints is {col:projects.velocity} story points. The backlog holds {col:projects.points_open} open points in {col:projects.items_open} items, of which {col:projects.ready_pts} points are ready.

Sprints left at this velocity: {col:projects.sprints_left}. The open backlog is done on {col:projects.forecast_date}. The active sprint is number {col:projects.sprint_no} and its state is: {col:projects.sprint_state}.
The forecast moves when the velocity or the scope changes. We review it at every sprint review and tell the sponsor when the date moves.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Product backlog summary for the client contact
paragraphs: Product backlog summary of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:projects.name}. Client contact: {col:projects.contact}. Project manager: {col:projects.manager}.

The backlog holds {col:projects.items_open} open items worth {col:projects.points_open} story points. {col:projects.ready_pts} points are ready to start and {col:projects.unest} items still need an estimate.

Bugs make up {col:projects.bug_pct} of the open items ({col:projects.bugs_open} bugs). The bug check shows: {col:projects.bug_check}. The state of the backlog for the next sprints is: {col:projects.ready_state}.
We ask the client contact to confirm the order of the items before each sprint planning. Items without an estimate are discussed in the next refinement session.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Release notes for users and the client
paragraphs: Release notes of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Release: {col:releases.release} ({col:releases.release_id}). Project: {col:releases.project}. Release date: {col:releases.date}. Status: {col:releases.status}.
What the release contains: {col:releases.scope}.
The release is planned for sprint {col:releases.sprint_no} ({col:releases.target_sprint}). The state against its date is: {col:releases.state}.
Please test the points above and tell {col:releases.client_contact} or the project manager of any problem within the first days of use. Known problems are recorded as bugs in the product backlog.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Retrospective summary for the team
paragraphs: Retrospective summary of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:retros.project}. Sprint {col:retros.number}, held on {col:retros.held_on}. Facilitator: {col:retros.facilitator}.
What went well: {col:retros.went_well}.
What to improve: {col:retros.to_improve}.
The mood score of the team was {col:retros.mood} out of 5 and the check shows: {col:retros.mood_check}. {col:retros.open_actions} actions of this sprint are still open.
Each action has one owner and a due date on the Retrospective Actions sheet. We look at the open actions first at the next retrospective.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Stand-up record of one person and day
paragraphs: Stand-up record of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:standups.project}. Date: {col:standups.date}, time {col:standups.time}. Person: {col:standups.staff}.
Yesterday: {col:standups.yesterday}.
Today: {col:standups.plan_today}.
Blocker: {col:standups.blocker}. The blocker flag shows: {col:standups.state}.
A blocker with an owner goes on the Blockers sheet the same day. The project manager checks every open blocker at the next stand-up.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Board snapshot with work-in-progress report
paragraphs: Board snapshot of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:projects.name}. Project manager: {col:projects.manager}. Active sprint: number {col:projects.sprint_no}, {col:projects.sprint_state}.
On the board {col:projects.c_ready} cards are in Ready, {col:projects.c_prog} in progress, {col:projects.c_review} in review and {col:projects.c_done} are done.
Cards blocked: {col:projects.blocked}. Blockers open too long: {col:projects.old_blockers}. Columns over their work-in-progress limit: {col:projects.wip_over}.
A column over its limit stops new work until a card moves on. We start with the oldest blocked card at the next stand-up.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Epic status note for the client
paragraphs: Epic status note of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Epic: {col:epics.epic} ({col:epics.epic_id}). Project: {col:epics.project}. Owner: {col:epics.owner}. Target sprint: {col:epics.target_sprint}.

The epic holds {col:epics.items} items worth {col:epics.points} story points. {col:epics.done_pts} points are finished and {col:epics.left_pts} points are left, so {col:epics.pct} is done. The state is: {col:epics.state}.
Sprints still needed if the epic gets all of the velocity of the project: {col:epics.sprints_needed}. When other epics run at the same time it takes longer.
We discuss the order of the epics with the client contact at every sprint review.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

steps.label: Refine and estimate the items for the sprint
Check the capacity of every person
Agree the sprint goal with the client contact
Pick the items that fit the capacity
Hold the planning meeting
Check that every item has an owner and criteria
Share the sprint plan with the team and the client
Set the work-in-progress limits on the board
Collect new requests and bugs
Ask the client contact for priorities
Prepare the items to discuss
Hold the refinement session
Estimate the items in story points
Split items above thirteen points
Write the acceptance criteria
Mark the items ready
Start at the same time as every day
Each person tells yesterday, today and any blocker
Update the board during the meeting
Write down every blocker with an owner
Move long talks to after the stand-up
Chase the open blockers
Check the burndown line
Invite the sponsor and the client contact
Collect the finished items and plan the demo
Check every finished item against its criteria
Rehearse the demo
Hold the review
Record accepted points and feedback
Update the backlog with the feedback
Send the review summary to the sponsor
Collect ideas from the team before the meeting
Review the open actions of earlier sprints
Hold the retrospective
Record what went well and what to improve
Agree two or three actions with an owner
Add the actions with due dates
Share the summary with the team
Check the actions at a stand-up
Finish or stop the open items
Check the board against the definition of done
Record the points done
Move unfinished items to the next sprint or the backlog
Update the velocity
Archive the board of the sprint
Start the planning of the next sprint
Freeze the scope of the release
Finish the acceptance tests
Get the acceptance of the client contact
Write the release notes
Prepare the roll-back plan
Tell the users and the support team
Release
Check the first day after the release
Hold a short review of the release
Write the acceptance criteria
Build the item
Review the work with a second person
Test every acceptance criterion
Fix the bugs found
Update the documents
Show the item to the client contact
Move the card to Done
Give access to the board and the backlog
Explain the columns and the work-in-progress limits
Share the working agreements
Pair the person with a buddy
Add the person to the stand-up
Assign a first small item
Add the person to the capacity plan
Review the first sprint together

fa.Fill Projects with the projects that run: پر کردن پروژه ها با پروژه هایی که اسپرینت را اجرا می کنند: مدیر، مشتری، اسپانسر، مخاطب مشتری و فروشنده با تلفن های خود. نقاط باز، نقاط آماده، سرعت، تاریخ پیش بینی و شمارش هیئت مدیره خود را پر کنید.
fa.Fill Team with each person and Epics wit: تیم را با هر فرد و اپیکس را با قطعات بزرگ کار هر پروژه پر کنید. سپس هر آیتم را با اپیکس، نوع، اولویت، نقاط داستان و وضعیت خود به تولیدات به تاخیر افتاده اضافه کنید.
fa.Create each sprint on Sprints with its d: ایجاد هر اسپرینت در اسپرینت با تاریخ، هدف و نقاط متعهد. ثبت روزها و تمرکز هر فرد در ظرفیت اسپرینت برای دیدن ظرفیت در نقاط و بررسی در برابر آنچه اختصاص داده شده است.
fa.During the sprint put the cards on Board: در طول اسپرینت کارت ها را روی کارت های هیئت مدیره بگذارید، محدودیت ها را روی محدودیت های کار در حال انجام تنظیم کنید و هر جلسه ایستادن را روی جلسات روزانه بنویسید. کارت های مسدود شده و کارت های قدیمی به رنگ قرمز و زرد نشان داده می شوند.
fa.Count the points remaining each day on B: تعداد نقاط باقیمانده هر روز در داده های نمودار سوختگی و خواندن خط در برابر ایده آل. اسپرینت نشان داده شده در نمودار است که در تنظیمات در شروع تایپ شده است.
fa.When a card is finished add it to Cycle: هنگامی که یک کارت تمام می شود، آن را به زمان چرخه اضافه کنید تا زمان چرخه و کارت های تمام شده هر هفته را ببینید. هر مسدود کننده را در مسدود کننده ها با علت، صاحب و تاریخ آن ثبت کنید.
fa.After each sprint fill Sprint Reviews wi: بعد از هر اسپرینت بررسی اسپرینت را با امتیازات پذیرفته شده، سرعت در اسپرینت با یک یادداشت، بازنگری با خلق و خوی و اقداماتی که با گذشت زمان انجام می شود با یک مالک و یک تاریخ مقرر برای هر عمل پر کنید.
fa.Use Backlog Refinement for your refineme: از اصلاح پس مانده برای جلسات اصلاح خود استفاده کنید، برنامه ی آزادسازی برای هر نسخه و معیارهای پذیرش به طوری که انجام شده برای همه یکسان است. توافق نامه های کاری قوانین تیم خود را حفظ می کند و نشان می دهد که چه زمانی آنها را بررسی کنید.
fa.Use the 13 calculators for capacity, vel: از 13 ماشین حساب برای ظرفیت، سرعت، اسپرینت های باقیمانده، چک نمودار سوختگی، تاریخ انتشار، نقاط به روز، محدودیت های کار در حال پیشرفت، زمان چرخه، تعهد، وضعیت پس مانده، اشکال، حماسه ها و اگر.
fa.Print 10 sheets and 9 reports, follow 9: ۱۰ ورق و ۹ گزارش چاپ کنید، ۹ لیست چک را دنبال کنید و یک لینک پیام را بزنید تا یک چت با متن و شماره آماده را باز کنید.
fa.Read Sprints and Boards Dashboard and Ch: دوچرخه و تخته های داشبورد و نمودارها را هر هفته بخوانید: سرعت، تکمیل، کارت های مسدود شده، زمان چرخه، به اشتراک گذاشتن اشکال، اعمال باز باز و اسپرینت های باقی مانده.
fa.Delete the demo rows when you are ready: وقتی آماده شدید ردیف های نمایشی را پاک کنید و خودتان را تایپ کنید. هر ستون محاسبه شده، شکل و نمودار پس از آن با داده های شما کار می کند.
fa.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: همه فهرست‌های کشویی فایل اینجا هستند. اگر موردی را اینجا تغییر دهید، در همه برگه‌ها تغییر می‌کند.
fa.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: اطلاعات داشبورد از برگه‌های شما به‌روز می‌شود. برای دیدن سال‌های قبل، سال را تغییر دهید.
fa.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: در سلول زرد انتخاب کنید؛ بقیه خودکار تکمیل می‌شود. آماده چاپ است.
fa.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: متن پیام را اینجا ویرایش کنید؛ واژه‌های داخل آکولاد با اطلاعات هر ردیف جایگزین می‌شوند. پیوندها در جدول‌ها هستند.
fa.Choose a record: each step gets its due: یک مورد را انتخاب کنید؛ برای هر مرحله تاریخ انجام تعیین می‌شود. برای هر مورد یک نسخه از این برگه بسازید.
fa.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: نمودارهای برگه‌های شما. از سلول‌های زرد انتخاب کنید تا نمودارها و سنجه‌ها خودکار به‌روز شوند.

hi.Open Start and type your company name an: खोलें प्रारंभ और पीले कक्षों में अपनी कंपनी का नाम और अपनी सीमाएं टाइप करेंः एक स्प्रिंट में सप्ताह, एक व्यक्ति को एक केंद्रित दिन में समाप्त अंक, दिनों के बाद एक कार्ड या अवरोधक बहुत पुराना है, स्वस्थ बग शेयर, क्षमता सीमाएं।
hi.Fill Projects with the projects that run: परियोजनाओं को उन परियोजनाओं के साथ भरें जो स्प्रिंट चलाते हैंः प्रबंधक, ग्राहक, प्रायोजक, ग्राहक संपर्क और विक्रेता अपने फोन के साथ। खुले बिंदु, तैयार बिंदु, गति, पूर्वानुमान तिथि और बोर्ड की गिनती स्वयं भरें।
hi.Fill Team with each person and Epics wit: प्रत्येक व्यक्ति के साथ टीम और प्रत्येक परियोजना के बड़े काम के टुकड़ों के साथ महाकाव्य भरें। फिर प्रत्येक आइटम को महाकाव्य, प्रकार, प्राथमिकता, कहानी बिंदुओं और स्थिति के साथ उत्पाद बैकलॉग में जोड़ें।
hi.Create each sprint on Sprints with its d: स्प्रिंट पर अपनी तारीखों, लक्ष्य और प्रतिबद्ध बिंदुओं के साथ प्रत्येक स्प्रिंट बनाएं। स्प्रिंट क्षमता पर प्रत्येक व्यक्ति के दिनों और फोकस को रिकॉर्ड करें ताकि अंक में क्षमता को देखा जा सके और जो सौंपा गया है उसके खिलाफ जांच की जा सके।
hi.During the sprint put the cards on Board: स्प्रिंट के दौरान बोर्ड कार्ड पर कार्ड रखें, प्रगति में कार्य सीमाएँ पर सीमाएँ सेट करें और दैनिक स्टैंड-अप बैठकें पर प्रत्येक स्टैंड-अप बैठक लिखें। ब्लॉक किए गए कार्ड और पुराने कार्ड लाल और एम्बर में दिखाई देते हैं।
hi.Count the points remaining each day on B: बर्नडाउन चार्ट डेटा पर प्रत्येक दिन शेष बिंदुओं की गणना करें और आदर्श के खिलाफ लाइन पढ़ें। चार्ट पर दिखाया गया स्प्रिंट स्टार्ट पर सेटिंग में टाइप किया गया है।
hi.When a card is finished add it to Cycle: जब कोई कार्ड समाप्त हो जाता है तो उसे चक्र समय में जोड़ें ताकि चक्र का समय और प्रत्येक सप्ताह समाप्त होने वाले कार्ड देखे जा सकें। ब्लॉकर्स पर प्रत्येक ब्लॉकर को इसके कारण, मालिक और तिथियों के साथ रिकॉर्ड करें।
hi.After each sprint fill Sprint Reviews wi: प्रत्येक स्प्रिंट के बाद स्प्रिंट समीक्षा को स्वीकार किए गए अंकों के साथ, स्प्रिंट द्वारा गति को एक नोट के साथ, मनोदशा के साथ और पूर्वगामी कार्यवाही को एक मालिक और प्रत्येक क्रिया के लिए एक नियत तिथि के साथ भरें।
hi.Use Backlog Refinement for your refineme: बैकलॉग का परिष्करण का उपयोग अपने परिष्करण सत्रों के लिए, रिहाई योजना प्रत्येक रिलीज़ के लिए और स्वीकृति मानदंड के लिए करें ताकि यह सभी के लिए समान हो। कार्य समझौते आपकी टीम के नियमों को रखता है और दिखाता है कि उन्हें कब समीक्षा करना है।
hi.Use the 13 calculators for capacity, vel: क्षमता, गति, स्प्रिंट बचे, बर्नडाउन चार्ट चेक, रिलीज की तारीख, दिनों के लिए अंक, कार्य-इन-प्रगति सीमाएं, चक्र समय, प्रतिबद्धता, बैकलॉग स्वास्थ्य, बग्स, महाकाव्य और एक क्या-यदि के लिए 13 कैलकुलेटर का उपयोग करें।
hi.Print 10 sheets and 9 reports, follow 9: 10 शीट और 9 रिपोर्ट प्रिंट करें, 9 चेकलिस्ट का पालन करें और पाठ और नंबर तैयार के साथ चैट खोलने के लिए एक संदेश लिंक पर टैप करें।
hi.Read Sprints and Boards Dashboard and Ch: स्प्रिंट और बोर्ड डैशबोर्ड और चार्ट हर सप्ताह पढ़ेंः गति, पूरा, अवरुद्ध कार्ड, चक्र समय, बग साझा करें, खुले पीछे की क्रियाओं और स्प्रिंट छोड़ दिया.
hi.Delete the demo rows when you are ready: जब आप तैयार हों, तो डेमो पंक्तियों को हटा दें और अपना स्वयं का टाइप करें। प्रत्येक गणना किए गए स्तंभ, चित्र और चार्ट तब आपके डेटा के साथ काम करता है।
hi.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: इस फ़ाइल की हर ड्रॉप-डाउन सूची। यहाँ कोई आइटम बदलें और हर शीट में वह बदल जाएगा।
hi.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: आपकी शीटें अपने-आप अपडेट होती हैं। पुराना हिसाब देखने के लिए साल बदलें।
hi.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: पीले खाने में चुनें; बाकी अपने-आप भर जाएगा। प्रिंट करने के लिए तैयार।
hi.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: यहाँ संदेश का पाठ बदलें; {braces} के अंदर के शब्द हर पंक्ति की जानकारी से अपने-आप भरेंगे। लिंक तालिकाओं में हैं।
hi.Choose a record: each step gets its due: एक रिकॉर्ड चुनें: हर चरण की नियत तारीख अपने-आप मिलेगी। हर रिकॉर्ड के लिए इस शीट की एक प्रति बनाएँ।
hi.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: आपकी शीट के लाइव चार्ट। पीले खानों में चुनें और हर चार्ट व गेज अपने-आप अपडेट होगा।

zh.Share the sprint plan with the team and: 与团队和客户分享冲刺计划

zh.Ask the client contact for priorities: 询问客户联系人优先事项

zh.Mark the items ready: 将物品标记为准备就绪
zh.Each person tells yesterday, today and a: 每个人都讲述昨天、今天和任何阻碍

zh.Write down every blocker with an owner: 写下每个阻碍者及其所有者
zh.Move long talks to after the stand-up: 将长篇演讲移至站立会议之后
zh.Invite the sponsor and the client contac: 邀请赞助商和客户联系
zh.Check every finished item against its cr: 根据标准检查每个成品
zh.Update the backlog with the feedback: 使用反馈更新待办事项列表
zh.Send the review summary to the sponsor: 将审核摘要发送给申办者
zh.Collect ideas from the team before the m: 在会议前收集团队的想法
zh.Review the open actions of earlier sprin: 回顾早期冲刺的开放行动
zh.Record what went well and what to improv: 记录哪些进展顺利以及哪些需要改进
zh.Agree two or three actions with an owner: 与业主商定两到三项行动
zh.Add the actions with due dates: 添加带有截止日期的操作
zh.Check the actions at a stand-up: 检查站立会议上的行动
zh.Check the board against the definition o: 根据完成的定义检查董事会
zh.Move unfinished items to the next sprint: 将未完成的项目移至下一个冲刺或待办事项列表
zh.Archive the board of the sprint: 归档该冲刺的任务看板
zh.Review the work with a second person: 与第二个人一起审查工作
zh.Show the item to the client contact: 向客户联系人展示该商品
zh.Give access to the board and the backlog: 授予对董事会和待办事项列表的访问权限
zh.Explain the columns and the work-in-prog: 解释列和进行中的工作限制
zh.Add the person to the stand-up: 将人员添加到站立会议中
zh.Add the person to the capacity plan: 将人员添加到容量计划中
zh.Points committed and done per month: 每月承诺与完成的点数
zh.Velocity of closed sprints per month: 每月已关闭冲刺的速度
zh.Burndown of the sprint set on Start: “启动”表中设定冲刺的燃尽图
zh.Open story points by priority: 按优先级统计的未完成故事点
zh.Open retrospective actions per owner: 各负责人未关闭的回顾行动
zh.Open Start and type your company name an: 打开"开始",然后在黄色的单元中输入公司名称和自己的限制:冲刺的几周,一个人在一个集中的一天完成的分数,卡片或屏蔽器过时的几天,健康的错误分享,容量限制.
zh.Fill Projects with the projects that run: 填写项目与项目运行冲刺:经理,客户,赞助商,客户的联系和供应商与他们的电话. 开放点,准备点,速度,预测日期和板计数自己填写.
zh.Fill Team with each person and Epics wit: 在“团队”中填写每位成员,在“史诗”中填写各项目的大型工作项。然后将每个事项连同其史诗、类型、优先级、故事点和状态添加到产品待办列表中。
zh.Create each sprint on Sprints with its d: 创建每一个冲刺在冲刺的日期,目标和承诺的积分.记录每个人在 冲刺能力 的日和注意力,以看到积分能力和与分配的检查.
zh.During the sprint put the cards on Board: 在冲刺中把卡放在 董事会卡片 上,设置 工作正在进行的限制 上的极限,并在 每天的站立会议 上写每次站立会议. 封锁卡和旧卡以红色和珀色显示.
zh.Count the points remaining each day on B: 计算每天剩余的分数在 燃烧图数据 上,并读取对理想的线. 在图表上显示的冲刺是在开始设置中输入的.
zh.When a card is finished add it to Cycle: 当一个卡片完成时,将其添加到 周期时间 以查看周期时间和每周完成的卡片.记录每个封锁者在封锁者上,其原因,所有者和日期.
zh.After each sprint fill Sprint Reviews wi: 每次冲刺结束后,填写 冲刺测试 接受的积分, 冲刺速度 带有注释, 带有情绪的回顾和 追溯性诉讼 带有所有者和每个行动的到期日期.
zh.Use Backlog Refinement for your refineme: 使用 积累积累的改进 进行精炼, 释放计划 每个版本和 接受标准 所以完成意味着对每个人都一样. 工作协议 保持你的团队规则,并显示何时审查它们.
zh.Use the 13 calculators for capacity, vel: 使用13个计算器来计算容量,速度,剩下的冲刺,燃烧图查询,发布日期,日期,正在进行的工作限制,周期时间,承诺,滞后健康,错误,史诗和假设.
zh.Print 10 sheets and 9 reports, follow 9: 打印10张表格和9份报告, 按照9份检查清单,
zh.Read Sprints and Boards Dashboard and Ch: 每周阅读 冲刺和板块仪表板 和图表:速度,完成,封锁卡,循环时间,错误共享,开放回顾行动和剩下的冲刺.
zh.Delete the demo rows when you are ready: 每个计算列,图形和图表都会与您的数据一起工作.
zh.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: 本工作簿的所有下拉选项。修改此处的选项，所有工作表都会同步更新。
zh.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: 数据随工作表自动更新。更改年份即可查看往年数据。
zh.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: 在黄色单元格中选择，其余内容将自动填写。可直接打印。
zh.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: 在此编辑消息内容；大括号中的字段会自动从每行资料填入。相关链接位于各个表格中。
zh.Choose a record: each step gets its due: 选择一条记录：每个步骤都会生成到期日期。每条记录请复制一份此工作表。
zh.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: 工作表实时图表。在黄色单元格中选择后，所有图表和仪表图都会自动更新。

Планируйте спринты, ведите доску и прогнозируйте релиз
ru.Sprint capacity from days and focus: Емкость спринта по дням и фокусу

ru.points done in each closed sprint, the a: сделанные сторипоинты в каждом закрытом спринте, среднее за три спринта, тренд и предупреждение, если скорость падает два спринта подряд
ru.Burndown with ideal line and projection: Диаграмма сгорания с идеальной линией и прогнозом
ru.points remaining each sprint day against: оставшиеся сторипоинты по дням спринта против идеальной линии, прогнозная линия на оставшиеся дни и отставание в баллах
ru.Product backlog with the state of every: Бэклог продукта с состоянием каждого пункта
ru.every item shows if it needs an estimate: для каждого пункта видно: нужна ли оценка или владелец, готов ли он, находится ли в спринте или завершен; также возраст в днях и критерии приемки
ru.Board cards with days in work: Карточки доски и дни в работе
ru.each card shows its column, days in work: каждая карточка показывает колонку, дни в работе и отметку блокера, срочной или устаревшей задачи, поэтому самая старая работа видна первой
ru.cards in each column are counted against: карточки в каждой колонке сравниваются с лимитом доски, видны свободные места и предупреждение, когда колонка переполнена
ru.days from start to finish of every card,: дни от начала до завершения каждой карточки, доля карточек в пределах вашей цели, а также завершенные карточки и баллы в неделю
ru.each blocker has a cause, an owner and t: у каждого блокера есть причина, владелец и число открытых дней; блокер отмечен как открытый, открытый слишком долго или решенный.
ru.items, points and finished points of eac: пункты, баллы и выполненные баллы каждого эпика собираются из бэклога, с долей выполненного и числом оставшихся спринтов при скорости проекта

ru.every action has an owner and a due date: у каждого действия есть владелец и срок; статус: открыто, скоро срок, просрочено или выполнено, с числом дней просрочки

ru.We discuss the order of the epics with t: Мы обсуждаем порядок эпосов с клиентом на каждом обзоре спринта.
ru.Refine and estimate the items for the sp: Уточнить и оценить задачи для спринта

ru.Start at the same time as every day: Начинайте в то же время, что и каждый день
ru.Each person tells yesterday, today and a: Каждый человек говорит вчера, сегодня и любой блокировщик
ru.Invite the sponsor and the client contac: Пригласить спонсора и связаться с клиентом
ru.Collect the finished items and plan the: Соберите готовые предметы и спланируйте демонстрацию
ru.Check every finished item against its cr: Проверяйте каждую готовую вещь на соответствие ее критериям
ru.Collect ideas from the team before the m: Собирайте идеи от команды перед встречей
ru.Record what went well and what to improv: Запишите, что прошло хорошо, а что нужно улучшить
ru.Check the board against the definition o: Проверьте доску на соответствие определению готовности.
ru.Move unfinished items to the next sprint: Перенесите незавершенные задачи в следующий спринт или в бэклог.

ru.Points committed and done per month: Запланированные и выполненные баллы по месяцам
ru.Open Start and type your company name an: Откройте лист «Начать» и введите название компании и свои лимиты в желтых ячейках: недели в спринте, баллы, которые человек закрывает за сфокусированный день, дни, после которых карточка или блокер считается устаревшим, здоровую долю дефектов и лимиты емкости.
ru.Fill Projects with the projects that run: Заполните проекты с проектами, которые выполняют спринты: менеджер, клиент, спонсор, контактный клиент и поставщик с их телефонами.
ru.Fill Team with each person and Epics wit: Затем добавьте каждый элемент в Остаток продукции с его эпическим, типом, приоритетом, точками истории и статусом.
ru.Create each sprint on Sprints with its d: Создайте каждый спринт на Спринтах с его датами, целью и поставленными пунктами. Запишите дни и фокус каждого человека на Способность спринтов, чтобы увидеть способность в пунктах и проверку против того, что присвоено.
ru.During the sprint put the cards on Board: Во время спринта поместите карты на Карты для доски, установите пределы на Ограничения работы в процессе и запишите каждое стоящее собрание на Ежедневные встречи.
ru.Count the points remaining each day on B: Считать оставшиеся пункты каждый день на Данные графика сжигания и читать линию против идеала.
ru.When a card is finished add it to Cycle: Когда карта завершена, добавьте ее к Время цикла, чтобы увидеть время цикла и карты, завершенные каждую неделю.
ru.After each sprint fill Sprint Reviews wi: После каждого спринта заполните Обзоры спринтов с принятыми очками, Скорость по спринту с запиской, ретроспективы с настроением и Заявления с обратной связью с владельцем и датой окончания каждого действия.
ru.Use Backlog Refinement for your refineme: Используйте Усовершенствование задержки для ваших сеансов уточнения, План выпуска для каждого релиза и Критерии принятия так, чтобы это означало то же самое для всех. Рабочие соглашения сохраняет правила вашей команды и показывает, когда их пересматривать.
ru.Use the 13 calculators for capacity, vel: Используйте 13 калькуляторов на пропускную способность, скорость, оставшиеся спринты, проверку сжигания графика, дату выпуска, дни, лимиты работы, время цикла, обязательства, состояние задержки, ошибки, эпосы и что если.
ru.Print 10 sheets and 9 reports, follow 9: Напечатайте 10 листов и 9 отчетов, следуйте 9 контрольным спискам и нажмите на ссылку сообщения, чтобы открыть чат с текстом и номером.
ru.Read Sprints and Boards Dashboard and Ch: Читайте Спринты и доски приборная панель и графики каждую неделю: скорость, завершение, заблокированные карты, время цикла, обмен ошибками, открытые ретроспективные действия и оставшиеся спринты.
ru.Delete the demo rows when you are ready: Удалите демонстрационные строки, когда вы готовы, и введите свои собственные. Каждая рассчитанная колонка, фигура и диаграмма затем работает с вашими данными.
ru.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Все выпадающие списки книги. Измените пункт здесь — он обновится на всех листах.
ru.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Данные обновляются по вашим листам. Измените год, чтобы посмотреть прошлые периоды.
ru.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Выберите значение в жёлтой ячейке — остальные заполнятся автоматически. Готово к печати.
ru.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Измените текст здесь; слова в скобках подставляются из каждой строки. Ссылки находятся в таблицах.
ru.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Выберите запись — для каждого этапа появится срок. Создайте копию листа для каждой записи.
ru.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Актуальные диаграммы по данным ваших листов. Выберите значения в жёлтых ячейках — диаграммы и индикаторы обновятся автоматически.

Accords de travail garde les règles de votre équipe et montre quand les revoir.

es.Open Start and type your company name an: Abra Inicio y escriba el nombre de su empresa y sus propios límites en las celdas amarillas: semanas en un sprint, puntos que una persona termina en un día específico, días después de que una tarjeta o bloqueador es demasiado viejo, cuota de errores saludable, límites de capacidad.
es.Fill Projects with the projects that run: Llenar los proyectos con los proyectos que ejecutan los sprints: gerente, cliente, patrocinador, contacto del cliente y proveedor con sus teléfonos.
es.Fill Team with each person and Epics wit: Llenar el equipo con cada persona y Epics con las grandes piezas de trabajo de cada proyecto.
es.Create each sprint on Sprints with its d: Crear cada sprint en Sprints con sus fechas, objetivos y puntos comprometidos.
es.During the sprint put the cards on Board: Durante el sprint, coloque las cartas en Tarjetas de la mesa, establezca los límites en Límites de trabajo en curso y escriba cada reunión en Reuniones diarias de pie.
es.Count the points remaining each day on B: Cuenta los puntos restantes cada día en Datos del gráfico de quema y lee la línea contra el ideal.
es.When a card is finished add it to Cycle: Cuando una tarjeta esté terminada, añádela a Tiempos de ciclo para ver el tiempo del ciclo y las tarjetas terminadas cada semana.
es.After each sprint fill Sprint Reviews wi: Después de cada sprint llenar Revisiones de los sprints con los puntos aceptados, Velocidad por sprint con una nota, Retrospectivas con el estado de ánimo y Acciones retroactivas con un propietario y una fecha de vencimiento para cada acción.
es.Use Backlog Refinement for your refineme: Use Refinamiento del inventario para sus sesiones de refinamiento, Plan de liberación para cada versión y Criterios de aceptación para que lo hecho signifique lo mismo para todos. Los acuerdos de trabajo mantiene las reglas de su equipo y muestra cuándo revisarlas.
es.Use the 13 calculators for capacity, vel: Utilice las 13 calculadoras para la capacidad, velocidad, sprints, la comprobación de la tabla de quemado, la fecha de lanzamiento, puntos a días, límites de trabajo en progreso, tiempo de ciclo, el compromiso, salud de la cartera, errores, épicos y un qué-si.
es.Print 10 sheets and 9 reports, follow 9: Imprima 10 hojas y 9 informes, siga 9 listas de verificación y toque un enlace de mensaje para abrir un chat con el texto y el número listos.
es.Read Sprints and Boards Dashboard and Ch: Leer Sprints y tableros tablero de instrumentos y gráficos cada semana: velocidad, finalización, tarjetas bloqueadas, tiempo de ciclo, error compartido, acciones retrospectivas abiertas y los sprints que quedan.
es.Delete the demo rows when you are ready: Elimine las filas de demostración cuando esté listo y escriba su propia. Cada columna calculada, figura y gráfico luego trabaja con sus datos.
es.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Todas las listas desplegables del archivo. Cambia aquí el nombre de un elemento y se actualizará en todas las hojas.
es.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Se actualiza con los datos de tus hojas. Cambia el año para consultar años anteriores.
es.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Elige en la celda amarilla; el resto se completa automáticamente. Listo para imprimir.
es.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Edita aquí el texto; las palabras entre {llaves} se completan con los datos de cada fila. Los enlaces están en las tablas.
es.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Elige un registro: cada paso tendrá su fecha límite. Haz una copia de esta hoja para cada caso.
es.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Gráficos actualizados con los datos de tus hojas. Elige en las celdas amarillas y los gráficos e indicadores se actualizarán automáticamente.

de.Team member: card in work too long: Teammitglied: Karte zu lange in Arbeit
de.Hello {assignee}, card {card_id} ({title: Hallo {assignee}, die Karte {card_id} ({title}) ist seit {age} Tagen im Einsatz. Ist sie immer noch auf Kurs? Bitte aktualisieren Sie das Board oder teilen Sie die Karte.
de.Hello {staff}, the stand-up of {project}: Hallo {staff}, das Stand-up von {project} findet um {time} statt. Bitte bringen Sie mit, was Sie gestern erledigt haben, was Sie heute planen, und alle Blocker.
de.Hello {facilitator}, the refinement sess: Hallo {facilitator}, die Verfeinerungssitzung von {project} findet am {date} statt. Bitte bringen Sie Schätzungen für die Einträge ohne Story Points mit.
de.Hello {owner}, the retrospective action: Hallo {owner}, die retrospektive Aktion "{action}" ist am {due} fällig. Bitte beenden Sie sie oder sagen Sie uns, was im Weg ist.
de.Team member: write the criteria: Teammitglied: Schreiben Sie die Kriterien auf
de.Hello {assignee}, item {item_id} ({title: Hallo {assignee}, Artikel {item_id} ({title}) hat {criteria_n} Akzeptanzkriterien. Bitte fügen Sie die fehlenden vor Beginn des Sprints hinzu.
Hallo {assignee}, das Element {item_id} ({title}) auf {project} wird Ihnen mit Priorität {priority} und {points} Punkten zugewiesen.
de.Team member: limit reached on the board: Teammitglied: Limit auf der Tafel erreicht
de.Hello {keeper}, the {lane} column of {pr: Hallo {keeper}, die {lane} Spalte von {project} enthält {cards} Karten gegen ein Limit von {limit}. Bitte beenden Sie eine Karte, bevor Sie eine neue ziehen.
de.Team member: prepare the sprint demo: Teammitglied: Bereiten Sie die Sprint-Demo vor
de.Hello {presenter}, the demo of sprint {n: Hallo {presenter}, die Demo von Sprint {number} in {project} findet am {demo_date} statt. Bitte bereiten Sie die Demo der {done_pts} abgeschlossenen Punkte vor.
de.Hello {pm_name}, sprint {number} of {pro: Hallo {pm_name}, Sprint {number} von {project} zeigt: {state}. {done} von {committed} Punkte sind fertig. Bitte entscheiden, was zu bewegen, bevor das Ende auf {end}.
Hallo {pm_name}, Sprint {number} von {project} hat {carry} Punkte nicht abgeschlossen. Bitte platzieren Sie sie in den nächsten Sprint oder den Backlog.
de.Hello {manager}, the velocity of {projec: Hallo {manager}, die Geschwindigkeit von {project} im Sprint {number} war {done} Punkte, Trend: {trend}.
de.Hello {manager}, the backlog of {name} h: Hallo {manager}, der Backlog von {name} hält {ready_pts} Bereitschaftspunkte mit einer Geschwindigkeit von {velocity}: {ready_state}.
de.Hello {manager}, blockers open too long: Hallo {manager}, Blocker bei {name} sind zu lange offen: {old_blockers}. Bitte helfen Sie dem Team, sie heute zu beseitigen.
de.Hello {sponsor}, you are invited to the: Hallo {sponsor}, Sie sind zur Überprüfung von Sprint {number} in {project} am {demo_date} eingeladen. Wir zeigen {done_pts} abgeschlossene Punkte. Bitte bestätigen Sie.
de.Hello {sponsor}, in the review of sprint: Hallo {sponsor}, bei der Überprüfung von Sprint {number} in {project} hat der Kunde {accepted} von {done_pts} Punkten akzeptiert. Nächster Schritt: {next_step}.
de.Hello {sponsor}, at a velocity of {veloc: Hallo {sponsor}, bei einer Velocity von {velocity} Punkten ist der offene Backlog von {name} voraussichtlich am {forecast_date} abgeschlossen. Verbleibende Sprints: {sprints_left}.
de.Hello {client_contact}, the refinement s: Hallo {client_contact}, die Verfeinerungssitzung von {project} findet am {date} statt. Bitte bringen Sie Ihre Prioritäten mit, damit wir den Backlog gemeinsam ordnen können.
de.Hello {client_contact}, release {release: Hallo {client_contact}, die Veröffentlichung {release} von {project} ist für {date} geplant. Wir möchten Ihnen das Ergebnis vorher zeigen. Bitte schlagen Sie einen Zeitpunkt vor.
de.Hello {client_contact}, points of sprint: Hallo {client_contact}, Punkte des Sprints {number} von {project} warten auf Ihre Annahme: {to_accept}. Bitte akzeptieren Sie sie oder sagen Sie uns, was zu ändern.
de.Hello {client_contact}, new work in spri: Hallo {client_contact}, neue Arbeit in Sprint {number} von {project} bedeutet etwas der gleichen Größe muss gehen.
de.Hello {client_contact}, release {release: Hallo {client_contact}, die Freigabe {release} von {project} geht aus am {date}. Umfang: {scope}. Bitte sagen Sie uns, wenn etwas fehlt.
de.Vendor: capacity for the next sprints: Anbieter: Kapazität für die nächsten Sprints
de.Hello, we plan the next sprints of {name: Hallo, wir planen die nächsten Sprints von {name}. Wie viele Entwicklertage kann {vendor} vom Beginn des nächsten Sprints geben? Bitte antworten Sie diese Woche.
de.Hello, bug {item_id} on {project} ({titl: Hallo, Fehler {item_id} in {project} ({title}) hat die Priorität {priority}. Bitte senden Sie uns Ihren Korrekturtermin und Ihre Schätzung in Story Points.
de.Hello {facilitator}, the retrospective o: Hallo {facilitator}, die Retrospektive von Sprint {number} in {project} findet am {held_on} statt. Noch offene frühere Maßnahmen: {open_actions}. Bitte beginnen Sie damit.
de.PMO lead: board over its limits: PMO-Führung: Das Unternehmen hat seine Grenzen überschritten
de.Hello, the board of {name}: columns over: Hallo, Board von {name}: Spalten über dem Limit {wip_over}, blockierte Karten {blocked}. Bitte klären Sie das diese Woche mit {manager}.
de.Sample wording: adapt it to your country: Beispieltext: an Landesrecht und Ihre Praxis anpassen
de.Sprint {col:sprints.number} of {col:spri: Sprint {col:sprints.number} von {col:sprints.project}, ID {col:sprints.sprint_id}. Status: {col:sprints.status}. Der Sprint läuft von {col:sprints.start} bis {col:sprints.end}. Projektleitung: {col:sprints.pm_name}.
de.The team commits {col:sprints.committed}: Das Team verbindet {col:sprints.committed} Story Points gegen eine Kapazität von {col:sprints.capacity} Points. Im Backlog {col:sprints.assigned} werden diesem Sprint Punkte zugewiesen. Der Commitment Check zeigt: {col:sprints.commit_check}.
de.A plan above {set:over_pct} of the capac: Ein Plan über {set:over_pct} der Kapazität benötigt Arbeit, die vor Beginn des Sprints ausgeführt werden muss. Ein Plan unter {set:under_pct} lässt Platz für einen weiteren Punkt aus dem bereitgestellten Backlog.
de.An item enters the sprint only with an e: Ein Gegenstand wird nur mit einer Schätzung, einem Eigentümer und Akzeptanzkriterien in den Sprint aufgenommen.
de.Project: {col:reviews.project}. Sprint {: Projekt: {col:reviews.project}. Sprint {col:reviews.number}, Überprüfung am {col:reviews.demo_date}. Präsentiert von {col:reviews.presenter}.
de.The team committed {col:reviews.committe: Das Team verpflichtete sich zu {col:reviews.committed} Story Points und beendete {col:reviews.done_pts}. Der Kunde akzeptierte {col:reviews.accepted} Punkte, also warten {col:reviews.to_accept} Punkte noch auf die Akzeptanz. Der Zustand der Akzeptanz ist: {col:reviews.state}.
de.Feedback of the client: {col:reviews.fee: Das Feedback des Kunden: {col:reviews.feedback}. Nächster Schritt: {col:reviews.next_step}.
de.Sponsor: {col:reviews.sponsor}. Client c: Sponsor: {col:reviews.sponsor}. Kundenkontakt: {col:reviews.client_contact}. Punkte werden akzeptiert, wenn alle Akzeptanzkriterien des Artikels erfüllt sind.
de.Please send any change request before th: Bitte schicken Sie jede Änderungsanfrage vor der nächsten Sprintplanung, damit wir sie ausmachen und in den Backlog platzieren können.
de.The average velocity of the last three c: Die durchschnittliche Geschwindigkeit der letzten drei geschlossenen Sprints beträgt {col:projects.velocity} Story Points. Der Backlog enthält {col:projects.points_open} offene Punkte in {col:projects.items_open} Elementen, von denen {col:projects.ready_pts} Punkte bereit sind.
de.Sprints left at this velocity: {col:proj: Verbleibende Sprints bei dieser Velocity: {col:projects.sprints_left}. Der offene Backlog wird am {col:projects.forecast_date} abgeschlossen. Der aktive Sprint ist Nummer {col:projects.sprint_no}, Status: {col:projects.sprint_state}.
de.The forecast moves when the velocity or: Wir überprüfen sie bei jeder Sprint-Überprüfung und sagen dem Sponsor, wann das Datum sich bewegt.
de.Product backlog summary for the client c: Übersicht des Produkt-Backlogs für den Kundenkontakt
de.The backlog holds {col:projects.items_op: Der Backlog enthält {col:projects.items_open} offene Elemente im Wert von {col:projects.points_open} Story Points. {col:projects.ready_pts} Punkte sind bereit zu starten und {col:projects.unest} Elemente benötigen noch eine Schätzung.
de.Bugs make up {col:projects.bug_pct} of t: Bugs bilden {col:projects.bug_pct} der offenen Elemente ({col:projects.bugs_open} Bugs). Die Fehlerprüfung zeigt: {col:projects.bug_check}. Der Stand des Backlogs für die nächsten Sprints ist: {col:projects.ready_state}.
de.We ask the client contact to confirm the: Wir bitten den Kundenkontakt, die Reihenfolge der Elemente vor jeder Sprintplanung zu bestätigen.
de.The release is planned for sprint {col:r: Die Freigabe ist für Sprint {col:releases.sprint_no} ({col:releases.target_sprint}) geplant. Der Stand gegenüber dem Termin ist: {col:releases.state}.
de.Please test the points above and tell {c: Bitte testen Sie die oben genannten Punkte und informieren Sie {col:releases.client_contact} oder den Projektmanager über alle Probleme innerhalb der ersten Tage der Nutzung.
de.The mood score of the team was {col:retr: Die Stimmung des Teams war {col:retros.mood} von 5 und der Check zeigt: {col:retros.mood_check}. {col:retros.open_actions} Aktionen dieses Sprints sind noch offen.
de.Each action has one owner and a due date: Jede Aktion hat einen Eigentümer und ein Fälligkeitsdatum auf dem Blatt Zurückwirkende Klagen.
de.Stand-up record of one person and day: Stand-up-Protokoll einer Person an einem Tag
de.A blocker with an owner goes on the Bloc: Ein Blocker mit Eigentümer geht am selben Tag auf das Blockers-Blatt. Der Projektmanager überprüft jeden offenen Blocker bei den nächsten Stand-up-Meetings.
de.On the board {col:projects.c_ready} card: Auf dem Brett sind {col:projects.c_ready} Karten in Bereitschaft, {col:projects.c_prog} im Gange, {col:projects.c_review} in Überprüfung und {col:projects.c_done} sind fertig.
de.Cards blocked: {col:projects.blocked}. B: Karten blockiert: {col:projects.blocked}. Blocker öffnen zu lange: {col:projects.old_blockers}. Spalten über ihre Arbeitszeitgrenze: {col:projects.wip_over}.
de.A column over its limit stops new work u: Eine Spalte über der Grenze stoppt neue Arbeiten, bis eine Karte weitergeht.
de.The epic holds {col:epics.items} items w: Das Epos enthält {col:epics.items} Elemente im Wert von {col:epics.points} Story Points. {col:epics.done_pts} Punkte sind fertig und {col:epics.left_pts} Punkte sind übrig, also {col:epics.pct} ist fertig. Der Zustand ist: {col:epics.state}.
de.Sprints still needed if the epic gets al: Sprints sind immer noch notwendig, wenn das Epos die gesamte Geschwindigkeit des Projekts erhält: {col:epics.sprints_needed}.
de.We discuss the order of the epics with t: Wir besprechen die Reihenfolge der Epen mit dem Kundenkontakt bei jeder Sprint-Überprüfung.
de.Refine and estimate the items for the sp: Verfeinern und schätzen Sie die Elemente für den Sprint
de.Check the capacity of every person: Überprüfen Sie die Leistungsfähigkeit jeder Person
de.Agree the sprint goal with the client co: Vereinbaren Sie das Sprintziel mit dem Kundenkontakt
de.Pick the items that fit the capacity: Wählen Sie die Artikel aus, die zur Kapazität passen
de.Check that every item has an owner and c: Überprüfen Sie, ob jedes Element einen Eigentümer und Kriterien hat
de.Share the sprint plan with the team and: Teilen Sie den Sprintplan mit dem Team und dem Kunden
de.Set the work-in-progress limits on the b: Legen Sie die Work-in-Progress-Limits an der Tafel fest
de.Collect new requests and bugs: Sammeln Sie neue Anfragen und Fehler
de.Ask the client contact for priorities: Fragen Sie den Kundenkontakt nach Prioritäten
de.Prepare the items to discuss: Bereiten Sie die zu besprechenden Punkte vor
de.Estimate the items in story points: Schätzen Sie die Elemente in Story Points
de.Split items above thirteen points: Teilen Sie Elemente über dreizehn Punkten auf
de.Mark the items ready: Markieren Sie die Artikel als bereit
de.Start at the same time as every day: Beginnen Sie jeden Tag zur gleichen Zeit
de.Each person tells yesterday, today and a: Jede Person erzählt gestern, heute und jeden Blocker
de.Update the board during the meeting: Aktualisieren Sie das Board während des Meetings
de.Write down every blocker with an owner: Notieren Sie jeden Blocker mit einem Besitzer
de.Move long talks to after the stand-up: Verlegen Sie lange Gespräche nach den Stand-up-Meetings
de.Check the burndown line: Überprüfen Sie die Linie des Burndown-Diagramms
de.Invite the sponsor and the client contac: Laden Sie den Sponsor und den Kundenkontakt ein
de.Collect the finished items and plan the: Sammeln Sie die fertigen Artikel und planen Sie die Demo
de.Check every finished item against its cr: Überprüfen Sie jeden fertigen Artikel anhand seiner Kriterien
de.Record accepted points and feedback: Notieren Sie akzeptierte Punkte und Feedback
de.Update the backlog with the feedback: Aktualisieren Sie den Rückstand mit dem Feedback
de.Send the review summary to the sponsor: Senden Sie die Zusammenfassung der Bewertung an den Sponsor
de.Collect ideas from the team before the m: Sammeln Sie vor dem Meeting Ideen vom Team
de.Review the open actions of earlier sprin: Überprüfen Sie die offenen Aktionen früherer Sprints
de.Record what went well and what to improv: Notieren Sie, was gut gelaufen ist und was verbessert werden muss
de.Agree two or three actions with an owner: Vereinbaren Sie zwei oder drei Maßnahmen mit einem Eigentümer
de.Add the actions with due dates: Fügen Sie die Aktionen mit Fälligkeitsterminen hinzu
de.Share the summary with the team: Teilen Sie die Zusammenfassung mit dem Team
de.Check the actions at a stand-up: Überprüfen Sie die Aktionen bei einem Stand-up-Meeting
de.Finish or stop the open items: Beenden oder stoppen Sie die offenen Posten
de.Check the board against the definition o: Überprüfen Sie das Board anhand der Definition von „Fertig“.
de.Move unfinished items to the next sprint: Verschieben Sie unfertige Elemente in den nächsten Sprint oder das Backlog
de.Archive the board of the sprint: Archivieren Sie das Board des Sprints
de.Start the planning of the next sprint: Beginnen Sie mit der Planung des nächsten Sprints
de.Freeze the scope of the release: Frieren Sie den Umfang der Veröffentlichung ein
de.Get the acceptance of the client contact: Erhalten Sie die Akzeptanz des Kundenkontakts
de.Tell the users and the support team: Informieren Sie die Benutzer und das Support-Team
de.Check the first day after the release: Überprüfen Sie den ersten Tag nach der Veröffentlichung
de.Hold a short review of the release: Halten Sie einen kurzen Rückblick auf die Veröffentlichung
de.Review the work with a second person: Überprüfen Sie die Arbeit mit einer zweiten Person
de.Show the item to the client contact: Zeigen Sie den Artikel dem Kundenkontakt
de.Give access to the board and the backlog: Gewähren Sie Zugriff auf das Board und den Backlog
de.Explain the columns and the work-in-prog: Erklären Sie die Spalten und die Work-in-Progress-Grenzen
de.Pair the person with a buddy: Koppeln Sie die Person mit einem Kumpel
de.Add the person to the stand-up: Fügen Sie die Person zu den Stand-up-Meetings hinzu
de.Assign a first small item: Weisen Sie einen ersten kleinen Artikel zu
de.Add the person to the capacity plan: Fügen Sie die Person dem Kapazitätsplan hinzu
de.Review the first sprint together: Lassen Sie den ersten Sprint gemeinsam Revue passieren
de.Points committed and done per month: Zugesagte und erledigte Punkte je Monat
de.Open Start and type your company name an: Öffnen Sie Start und geben Sie Ihren Firmennamen und Ihre eigenen Grenzen in die gelben Zellen ein: Wochen in einem Sprint, Punkte, die eine Person an einem bestimmten Tag beendet, Tage, an denen eine Karte oder ein Blocker zu alt ist, gesunde Fehleranteile, Kapazitätslimits.
de.Fill Projects with the projects that run: Füllen Sie die Projekte mit den Projekten, die Sprints ausführen: Manager, Kunde, Sponsor, Kundenkontakt und Anbieter mit ihren Telefonen.
de.Fill Team with each person and Epics wit: Füllen Sie Team mit jeder Person und Epics mit den großen Arbeiten jedes Projekts.
de.Create each sprint on Sprints with its d: Erstellen Sie jeden Sprint auf Sprints mit seinen Terminen, Ziel und verpflichteten Punkten.
de.During the sprint put the cards on Board: Während des Sprints legen Sie die Karten auf Karten für das Brett, setzen Sie die Grenzen auf Grenzwerte für laufende Arbeiten und schreiben Sie jedes Stand-up-Meeting auf Tägliche Stand-up-Treffen.
de.Count the points remaining each day on B: Zählen Sie die verbleibenden Punkte an jedem Tag auf Verbrennungsdiagrammdaten und lesen Sie die Linie gegen das Ideal.
de.When a card is finished add it to Cycle: Wenn eine Karte fertig ist, fügen Sie sie zu Zykluszeiten hinzu, um die Zykluszeit und die Karten zu sehen, die jede Woche fertig sind.
de.After each sprint fill Sprint Reviews wi: Nach jedem Sprint füllen Sie Sprint-Überprüfungen mit den angenommenen Punkten, Geschwindigkeit im Sprint mit einer Notiz, Retrospektiven mit der Stimmung und Zurückwirkende Klagen mit einem Eigentümer und einem Fälligkeitsdatum für jede Aktion.
de.Use Backlog Refinement for your refineme: Verwenden Sie Verfeinerung des Rückstands für Ihre Verfeinerungs-Sitzungen, Freisetzungsplan für jede Version und Annahmekriterien so dass das getan bedeutet, dass die gleiche für alle. Arbeitsvereinbarungen hält Ihre Team-Regeln und zeigt, wann sie zu überprüfen.
de.Use the 13 calculators for capacity, vel: Verwenden Sie die 13 Rechner für Kapazität, Geschwindigkeit, verbleibende Sprints, die Verbrennungsdiagrammprüfung, das Veröffentlichungsdatum, Punkte zu Tagen, Arbeitslaufzeiten, Zykluszeit, die Verpflichtung, Rückstandsgesundheit, Bugs, Epen und ein Was-wenn.
de.Print 10 sheets and 9 reports, follow 9: Drucken Sie 10 Blätter und 9 Berichte, folgen Sie 9 Checklisten und tippen Sie auf einen Nachrichtenlink, um einen Chat mit Text und Nummer zu eröffnen.
de.Read Sprints and Boards Dashboard and Ch: Lesen Sie Sprints und Boards Armaturenbrett und Diagramme jede Woche: Geschwindigkeit, Fertigstellung, gesperrte Karten, Zykluszeit, Fehlerfreigabe, offene rückblickende Aktionen und die verbleibenden Sprints.
de.Delete the demo rows when you are ready: Löschen Sie die Demo-Zeilen, wenn Sie fertig sind, und geben Sie Ihre eigenen ein. Jede berechnete Spalte, Abbildung und Diagramm arbeitet dann mit Ihren Daten.
de.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle Auswahllisten dieser Datei. Ändere hier einen Eintrag, und er wird in allen Tabellen übernommen.
de.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wird anhand deiner Tabellen aktualisiert. Ändere das Jahr, um frühere Daten anzusehen.
de.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Wähle die gelbe Zelle aus; der Rest wird automatisch ausgefüllt. Druckbereit.
de.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Bearbeite den Text hier; Wörter in {Klammern} werden aus jeder Zeile übernommen. Die Verknüpfungen findest du in den Tabellen.
de.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Wähle einen Eintrag aus: Für jeden Schritt wird das Fälligkeitsdatum berechnet. Erstelle für jeden Eintrag eine Kopie dieses Tabellenblatts.
de.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Aktuelle Diagramme deiner Tabellen. Wähle die gelben Zellen aus, und alle Diagramme und Messanzeigen werden automatisch aktualisiert.

it.Plan sprints, run the board and forecast: Pianificare sprint, gestire la board e prevedere il rilascio in Excel
Pianificare sprint, gestire la board e prevedere il rilascio
it.Sprint capacity from days and focus: Capacità sprint da giorni e focus
it.days available and the focus factor of e: giorni disponibili e fattore di focus di ogni persona danno la capacità in story point, confrontata con i punti assegnati, con controllo di eccesso o carenza
it.points done in each closed sprint, the a: punti completati in ogni sprint chiuso, media di tre sprint, tendenza e avviso quando la velocity scende per due sprint consecutivi
it.Burndown with ideal line and projection: Burndown con linea ideale e proiezione
it.points remaining each sprint day against: punti rimanenti ogni giorno di sprint rispetto alla linea ideale, con la linea di proiezione per i giorni futuri e lo scarto in punti
it.Product backlog with the state of every: Product backlog con stato di ogni voce
it.every item shows if it needs an estimate: ogni voce indica se serve una stima o un responsabile, se è pronta, se è in uno sprint o completata, con età in giorni e criteri scritti
it.Board cards with days in work: Schede di board con giorni in lavorazione
it.each card shows its column, days in work: ogni scheda mostra la colonna, i giorni in lavorazione e un contrassegno per bloccata, urgente o ferma, così il lavoro più vecchio emerge per primo
it.Work-in-progress limits with a check: Limiti del lavoro in corso con controllo
it.cards in each column are counted against: le schede di ogni colonna sono confrontate con il limite della board, con lo spazio residuo e un avviso quando una colonna supera il limite
it.days from start to finish of every card,: giorni dall'inizio alla fine di ogni scheda, quota entro l'obiettivo, schede e punti completati a settimana
it.each blocker has a cause, an owner and t: ogni bloccante ha causa, responsabile e giorni aperti, ed è segnato come aperto, aperto da troppo tempo o risolto
it.items, points and finished points of eac: elementi, punti e punti completati di ogni epica sono riepilogati dal backlog, con quota completata e sprint residui alla velocity del progetto
it.Sprint reviews with accepted points: Review di sprint con punti accettati
it.points done, points accepted by the clie: punti completati, punti accettati dal cliente e punti ancora da accettare, con feedback e prossimo passo di ogni review
it.Retrospective actions with days late: Azioni di retrospettiva con giorni di ritardo
it.every action has an owner and a due date: ogni azione ha un responsabile e una scadenza ed è segnata come aperta, in scadenza, in ritardo o completata, con i giorni di ritardo
it.Release plan with days to the date: Piano di rilascio con giorni alla data
it.each release has a target sprint, a date: ogni rilascio ha uno sprint obiettivo, una data e uno stato, con i giorni mancanti e il referente del cliente da avvisare
it.Backlog health score for every project: Punteggio di salute del backlog per progetto
it.ready points, estimates, bug share and o: punti pronti, stime, quota di bug e vecchi bloccanti si combinano in un punteggio da 0 a 100 e in un giudizio pronto o non pronto
it.Acceptance criteria with who checked the: Criteri di accettazione e chi li ha verificati
it.each item carries its criteria and wheth: ogni elemento riporta i suoi criteri e se sono soddisfatti, così completato significa la stessa cosa per il team e per il cliente
it.Days ahead to warn of a due date: Giorni di anticipo per segnalare una scadenza
it.Story points one person finishes in a fo: Story point che una persona completa in una giornata concentrata
it.Days after which a card in work is stale: Giorni dopo i quali una scheda in lavorazione è ferma
it.Days after which an open blocker is too: Giorni dopo i quali un bloccante aperto è troppo vecchio
it.Highest healthy share of bugs in the bac: Quota massima sana di bug nel backlog
it.Plan above this share of capacity is ove: Piano sopra questa quota di capacità è in eccesso
it.Plan below this share of capacity is und: Piano sotto questa quota di capacità è in carenza
it.Cycle time target of a card, days: Obiettivo di cycle time di una scheda, in giorni
it.Sprints of ready work a healthy backlog: Sprint di lavoro pronto che un backlog sano deve contenere
it.Sprint shown on the burndown chart (spri: Sprint mostrato nel grafico di burndown (ID sprint)
it.Share of the points that counts as the s: Quota dei punti che conta come obiettivo di sprint raggiunto
it.Burn pace from which an active sprint is: Ritmo di burndown da cui uno sprint attivo è in linea
it.Days after which a working agreement is: Giorni dopo i quali un accordo di lavoro va rivisto
it.Waiting for another team: In attesa di un altro team
